description: agent-action under v57 exercising stamp:sign(content_hash_prefix=abc). Every hash that starts with abc starts with ab, so it does not meet content_hash_prefix!=ab: verifier MUST reject with E_SCOPE_DENIED.

expected.rejection_reason: A hash-prefix value under != is met only by a prefix that no withheld hash can start with: neither value may be a prefix of the other. abc extends ab.
